Confusing Darkness.name: Confusing Darkness
Confusing Darkness.description: Caster creates a veil of heavy, magical darkness over the area. Manipulative apparitions lap away at the minds of the targets, confusing them should they end their turn in the area, WIL save to negate. This lasts until the end of the character's next turn or until they leave the area.

Dark Echo.name: Dark Echo
Dark Echo.description: Caster inscribes a 10' x 10' symbol onto the ground beneath them. Over the duration of the ability, the caster can expend their swift action to return to the symbol or return whatever is on top of the symbol to them. If whatever is lying atop the symbol is unwilling, they have a WIL save to negate

Darkport.name: Darkport
Darkport.description: All willing targets disappear in a flash of darkness, before reappearing at another target location - though the target location must be shrouded in darkness.

Dark Bastion.name: Dark Bastion
Dark Bastion.description: Caster manifests darkness into a small pocket dimension, creating a 2鈥 diameter ball of black, rubbery material. At any point during the duration of this spell, whoever holds the ball may open up a single 4' radius portal as Swift Action; the portal may also be closed as a Swift Action. Only one portal may be open at a time; opening a new portal closes the old one. Within the portal is a dark, empty, dome shaped room with a radius of 25'. At the end of the duration, the room starts slowly collapsing and all objects within the room are gently expelled.

Eternal Darkness.name: Eternal Darkness
Eternal Darkness.description: Magical darkness spreads outwards from the chosen point, inflicting 4 + 1/2F d12 stress damage, WIL save for half. If the areas of Shadow Slick, Confusing Darkness, Shadowflash, or Stifling Darkness overlap with this spell's area, they extend to cover this spell's area as well.

Grappling Darkness.name: Grappling Darkness
Grappling Darkness.description: Tendrils of darkness fly from the caster's fingertips, attempting to grapple the targets. The caster makes a ranged attack roll against each target, pinning them on hit. As a swift action the caster can pull grappled targets up to 30' closer to themselves while the spell is active. On subsequent rounds affected targets can attempt a STR or AGI check using their swift action to break free.

Hopelessness.name: Hopelessness
Hopelessness.description: Grim thoughts bear into the minds of the targets, forcing them to feel as though they are fighting for naught - giving them 2 displaced rolls on setting resistance checks, WIL check to negate. If their odds of victory are low, the target may feel compelled to retreat. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Shade.name: Shade
Shade.description: Target is transformed into an ethereal, invisible creature that can pass through all obstacles. While they can see the material world, they cannot affect it nor be affected by it using any physical or magical means. The target can enable and disable this effect using a swift action.

Shadow Servants.name: Shadow Servants
Shadow Servants.description:
Malediction surrounds the caster, which is then directed at all selected targets, allowing the caster to either: 
Alter their motivation so long as it does not directly hurt themselves or people they care deeply for. 
Confuse them. 
Frighten them. 
WIL check to negate. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Shadow Slick.name: Shadow Slick
Shadow Slick.description: Shadows swim at the caster's discretion, breaking and reforming in twisting dark shapes as they shift the terrain, causing sight and touch to become unreliable. Targets within the area are slowed and targets who end their turn within the area are pinned until the start of their next turn, STR or AGI check to negate (target's choice.)

Shadowflash.name: Shadowflash
Shadowflash.description: A pall of darkness radiates from the caster, obscuring the area around them, making speech unintelligible to other characters, and transforming others in the area - making it difficult to tell who is who. Immediately upon casting this spell, and then as a Swift Action during all later turns the caster can switch places with another target within the area. Should the target be unwilling, they have a WIL save to negate

Shadowsight.name: Shadowsight
Shadowsight.description: Supernatural darkness swims in the target's eyes, congealing in their gaze, allowing them to see Rank*10' in natural darkness and Rank*5' in magical darkness. While under this spell's effect, the target may utilize their swift action to meet another target's gaze, forcing a contested check of WIL, causing them to become Frightened as the darkness in the character's eyes reflects an alien fear. Affected targets can re-attempt the check utilizing their swift action, becoming immune to effects from this spell for an hour on success. The visual effect of this spell does not extend the vision and terminates at the end of the target's natural vision if it is shorter.

Shadowform.name: Shadowform
Shadowform.description: Caster turns themselves into a dark-ghost like shadow, giving themselves resistance to all damage except divine and Pure_Magic. They are immaterial; they pass through all non magical, nonmetal objects, though they are still capable of casting spells. While in darkness, the caster can choose to dematerialize and subsequently materialize within 120' of their LOS if that location is also in darkness, immediately upon casting this spell, and then as a Swift Action during all later turns.

Shadow Poppet.name: Shadow Poppet
Shadow Poppet.description:
Targets have miniature shadow replicas created of them within the caster's grip or on their person, WIL check to negate. The poppets may only be used by the caster and they must have the poppet on their person to use it. Once per round caster may use a poppet as a swift action or reaction, using a poppet causes one of the following effects: 
Shadows pull the target 30' in any direction. 
Target becomes Frightened of the caster until the end of their next turn. 
Blind the target until the end of their next turn. 
Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Stygian Blur.name: Stygian Blur
Stygian Blur.description: Caster wraps themselves in a twisting cloak of shadows which snatch and consumes ambient shadows as it moves to defend its wearer and reflect back only shaded horror. Awareness checks against the caster inflict 2d8 stress damage and cause the target to lose any memlocks on them or their possessions, WIL save to negate. Additionally, the caster gains 2 + 1/4F bonus DVs and becomes invisible in darkness (this invisibility ends when targets come in physical contact with another creature in any way, or when the targets make any kind of check or save, resuming at the start of the next round should they still remain in darkness.)

Stifling Shadow.name: Stifling Shadow
Stifling Shadow.description: A devouring shadow forms and breaks like a rushing wave, flooding the area with twisting shadows, flowing into victims and suppressing their magical energy, causing them to become spell jammed while in the area, with a WIL save to instead have the 1 + 1/F maintained continuous or focus spells paused while they are in the area. All targets within the area treat all other targets within the area as having cover unless they can visually pierce magical darkness.

Umbrapush.name: Umbrapush
Umbrapush.description: A horrifying sheet of shadows spread outwards from the caster, inflicting 1 + 2/F d20 stress damage, pushing targets 15' backwards and inflicting frightened, WIL check for half damage and to negate the push/frighten. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action to remove frighten.

Umbral Momentum.name: Umbral Momentum
Umbral Momentum.description: Caster envelops the targets with the deepest shadow, causing them to absorb light and move at inhuman speeds. Targets take half damage from damaging spells that would force a target to make an AGI check/save, or originate from the Light Spell group (Making the check in either case negates the damage and effect). The movespeed of targets is also increased by 25' + 5'/F.
